newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-SECOND ARGENTINE PLAYER IN TALKS WITH BATH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SECOND ARGENTINE PLAYER IN TALKS WITH BATH.

text.p: English rugby union champions Bath will open talks with Argentine international lock German Llanes on Friday, the club said on Thursday.
Llanes has won 33 caps and was in outstanding form when Argentina lost 20-18 against England at Twickenham three weeks ago.
The huge 28-year-old Milan lock is a close friend of Bath's latest overseas signing, Pumas hooker Federico Mendez, and would end the club's lengthy search for a proven line-out ball winner.
Llanes made his test debut against Ireland six years ago and produced commanding performances during the 1995 World Cup.
Milan snapped him up after the tournament and, alongside Mendez, he is one of Argentina's few full-time rugby professionals.
